page.overview:
Who is Hawkeye?

Hawkeye is a unit and summonable vision in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. He is one of the six heroes in Trials of Mana and its 2020 remake. He is obtainable via the collaboration event with the Mana series.

Hawkeye is a noble thief from the remote desert fortress of Nevarl, well hidden in the Burning Sands of the southeast. He was a member of a guild that routinely stole from the wealthy to give to those in suffering. But when the leader of the guild, Flamekhan, is rescued by the witch Isabella, her influence prompts Flamekhan to disband the guild and declare Nevarl a kingdom, with a plan to invade other regions for control of the Mana Stones that hold the world in balance. When Hawkeye and his close friend Eagle are caught eavesdropping on Isabella and a vampiric conspirator, she manipulates Eagle into attacking Hawkeye to assassinate him. Hawkeye has no choice but to strike Eagle down, after which Isabella frames him for murder. Worse still, Isabella places a cursed choker on Eagle's sister Jessica; if Hawkeye should reveal the truth of what happened or kill Isabella, Jessica also dies. Now an exile, Hawkeye escapes Nevarl and searches for a means to dispel the curse and avenge Eagle. Category:Characters in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius Category:Non-Final Fantasy characters
